verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Pulumi serves an llms.txt at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a curated product summary), and a second llms.txt exists under /dev/. Pulumi also documents Agent Skills, knowledge packages built to teach AI coding assistants Pulumi workflows, so agents have purpose-built docs to point at. missing for 10: markdown-rendered docs pages (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt effectively

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt # Pulumi
Pulumi Agent Skills are knowledge packages that teach AI coding assistants domain-specific Pulumi workflows.
